to_json(t).title: Clarity of purpose.
to_json(t).body: The job, the buyer, and the constraint named before anything gets built. The site knows what it is for; the team can repeat it in one sentence.

to_json(t).title: Judgement in context.
to_json(t).body: Every decision tied to the brand, the buyer, and the number it is meant to move. If nothing measurable changes, the work is not done.

to_json(t).title: Room to grow.
to_json(t).body: Tokens, sections, and CMS structure built for the next campaign and the next market, so a new page costs an afternoon instead of a redesign.
